subject: Account usage ticking up for a sleeping app

messages.author: 480abc64f35a809e
messages.subject: Account usage ticking up for a sleeping app
parts:
Hi, 

I uploaded a shiny app a few months ago, but it is rarely accessed now. However somehow, shinyapps.io seems to think it was accessed 26 hours this month, including multiple times in the past 24 hours. the app overview claims that the app was updated today (which it was not - I have not updated the app in months). the app logs for those times include, repeatedly, just loading of a number of packages (e.g. BioGenerics, Ranges) that are probably required for the app, and ends with Listening on http://127.0.0.1:N . (N - 5 digit number which changes between instances). 

I would like to upload a new app, but it seems I somehow exceeded my time limit without me actually using it at all. Is this to do with the way I uploaded the previous app? Is this a known issue? 

Any advice would be great...

Many thanks!!
Anat

messages.subject: Re: Account usage ticking up for a sleeping app

What is the URL so we can look at why it might have been updated?
